about.description: rSPCX is a tokenized share of the Procure Space ETF issued by Reality on Arbitrum, designed to track the economic performance of the Procure Space ETF (SPCX) at a 1:1 ratio. Each rSPCX is backed by a corresponding ETF share held through Alpaca Securities LLC, a FINRA-registered and SIPC-covered US broker-dealer, with reserves continuously verified by The Network Firm through Reality's Proof of Asset dashboard. Note that Reality markets this token under the SpaceX brand for thematic exposure to space economy assets. The underlying ETF holds a diversified basket of publicly traded space and aerospace companies rather than direct SpaceX equity. Reality is a regulated RWA issuance platform within the Bitget ecosystem.
